summary: Platinum Analytics Cayman Limited, a Nasdaq-listed Singapore-domiciled FX trading software developer, furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release and unaudited condensed interim financial statements for the six months ended March 31, 2026. Revenue collapsed 91% to US$0.1 million as all previously contracted projects concluded with no new agreements signed; gross profit fell 93% to US$0.04 million, selling expenses surged to US$1.4 million, and G&A rose 45% to US$0.7 million. This is a routine earnings filing, not a special situation; watch for new contract signings and cash runway commentary.
